How this map works

Each set contributes 1 point to its main groups and 0.5 to supporting groups. One set can involve several groups. Colors are relative to the highest score in this view; use the set counts when comparing periods. This is a simplified exercise-based overview, not measured activation or recovery. Both sides show the same exercise history.
